data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's gross claims reserves at 1 Jan 2020 were GBP 798.7m. During 2020 the Syndicate recorded an overall adverse prior-year development of GBP 6.8m (a strengthening of reserves), driven by a combination of natural catastrophe activity, adverse/attritional development and a number of large loss movements across property, marine and liability-related classes. COVID-19 event cancellation losses (GBP 66.5m) materially impacted the contingency book (largely booked to the 2019 year). Reinsurance to Close activity in respect of earlier years also affected reserve reporting and distorted development metrics.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development figure taken from narrative in claims development section (explicit overall deterioration GBP 6.8m). The claims development triangle and movement notes are distorted by a Reinsurance To Close (RITC) of 2017 & prior years (transfer of c.GBP 279.4m) which makes diagonal-triangle calculations unreliable; the narrative figure may be net rather than gross and therefore confidence is reduced. Some LOB-level reserve movements are discussed qualitatively only and not quantified.
